_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With zero 12h windows showing ±2+ point movement over 74 samples and both brains reading structural tension without a directional breaker, HOLD is the skilled call — the coil persists until evidence forces resolution.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes — both brains agree the market is coiling sideways with no directional edge; Analyst is more explicit about the statistical base rate, Narrative is more descriptive of the macro tension, but the forward call is identical.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed breaks above 55 with BTC 30-day momentum above 60 and funding staying below 0.01% — signals Disbelief leg beginning with healthy skepticism
